name: claimguard
description: Root dev-orchestration only — actual code lives in backend/ and frontend/.

scripts.dev:phoenix: cd backend && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" uv run phoenix serve
scripts.dev:token-service: cd backend && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" uv run uvicorn auth.app:app --port 8100
scripts.dev:gateway: cd backend && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" uv run uvicorn data_gateway.app:app --port 8200
scripts.dev:agentos: cd backend && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" uv run uvicorn api.agentos:app --port 8000
scripts.dev:officer: cd backend && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" uv run uvicorn api.officer:app --port 8400
scripts.dev:hello-agent: cd backend && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" uv run python -m agents.hello_agent
scripts.seed: cd backend && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" uv run python -m data_gateway.seed
